name: load_event_resource

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_LoadEventResource consumes a load slot and resource ID, selects the slot-specific resource table and completion callback, queues the file into the resource ID's 0x100-byte event buffer, and decrements Script stackTop by two

notes: Load slots 1 and 2 allocate through distinct event-resource arenas and set asynchronous-load bits 33 and 34 respectively. Command 93 wait_for_event_resource_load polls those same slot values and bits. The JP corpus contains 68 calls.
